# Unicorn Studio

> Trusted AI integration partner for businesses. A specialist studio that builds AI Systems, AI Solutions, and full AI SaaS products, plus the website and brand to launch each one credibly. Guaranteed delivery, or we work for free until it runs.

Unicorn Studio is a small AI development studio founded by Saidur Rahaman. The studio specializes in four AI service lines and explicitly does not do generalist agency work. Every system is built custom to the client's business; off-the-shelf templates are not used. Average response time is under two hours during business hours.

The site itself is a static Next.js export with no public APIs. Contact submissions are forwarded via Web3Forms to saidur@unicornstudio.io. Bookings happen on Cal.com.

## Services

- [AI Systems](https://unicornstudio.io/ai-systems/): Custom AI automation built for an entire business — process, marketing, sales, and communication systems that run in the background.
- [AI Integrations](https://unicornstudio.io/ai-integrations/): Add AI capabilities to an existing product or workflow without rebuilding it.
- [AI Solutions](https://unicornstudio.io/ai-solutions/): Multi-agent orchestration, LLM fine-tuning, retrieval, NLP, perception, classical ML, and MLOps. Three engagement shapes: proof of concept (~3 weeks), complete solution (~8 weeks + 90-day stabilisation), combined engagement.
- [AI SaaS](https://unicornstudio.io/ai-saas/): End-to-end AI SaaS product builds — from first commit to launch. Real stacks (Next.js, Postgres, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector, Clerk, Stripe), real timelines.
- [Website](https://unicornstudio.io/websites/): Conversion-focused websites for AI SaaS founders. Tiered builds on WordPress, Webflow, or Framer.
- [Branding](https://unicornstudio.io/branding/): Brand identity systems built for AI SaaS products. Three concept directions, two rounds of refinement, trademark-ready files.

## Optional

- [Thank you](https://unicornstudio.io/thank-you/index.md): Post-submission confirmation page — not strategic content; safe to skip.
- [Sitemap](https://unicornstudio.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap with all crawlable URLs.
- [robots.txt](https://unicornstudio.io/robots.txt): Crawl policy (non-blocking; allows all well-behaved bots).
- [API catalog](https://unicornstudio.io/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 catalog, points at the OpenAPI description below.
- [OpenAPI description](https://unicornstudio.io/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the read-only content surface (Markdown twins, sitemap, llms.txt, well-known endpoints).
- [HTTP message signatures directory](https://unicornstudio.io/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory): JWKS-style key directory — empty keys array (no signing keys published).
- [OAuth authorization server metadata (RFC 8414)](https://unicornstudio.io/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): empty supported lists — the site does not run an OAuth authorization server.
- [OAuth protected resource metadata (RFC 9728)](https://unicornstudio.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): empty authorization-servers array — no protected resources here.
